nativePlatform.componentPreview: Native SwiftUI/AppKit source descriptions only. No HTML/CSS reconstruction, raster composition or synthetic tonal ramps are supplied; they would not preserve native controls, dynamic platform colors, materials or terminal rendering.

evidence.mode: Source scan; merged refresh of existing native design system.
evidence.renderAcceptance: No current-render acceptance claim. Prior review snapshots do not establish the result of this refresh.
evidence.behaviorAcceptance: No full F01–F24 or C01–C32 acceptance claim.
observedTargetDifferences: Pane frames are rectangular; macOS 26 outer-corner refinement is not established by this source scan.

components.name: Chrome Action
components.description: Compact native borderless SF Symbol action with contextual help; native focus and disabled states.

components.name: Sidebar Navigation
components.description: Plain full-row buttons inside persistent collapsible groups with pinned native headers; Space and Agent use distinct padding and radius tokens, with appearance-aware selected fill and neutral hover.

components.name: Agent Status
components.description: Shape, system color and accessible text convey working, blocked, unread, read and unknown states independently of tool identity.

components.name: Terminal Tab
components.description: Natural-width AppKit label with selected semibold weight, appearance-aware accent fill/outline, neutral hover, complete-title tooltip and reorder insertion line.

components.name: Terminal Pane
components.description: Mounted Ghostty surface inside a thin rectangular frame; embedded monospaced title and contextual close/restore controls.

components.name: Search
components.description: Native rounded-border search field, shared keyboard/hover result selection, contextual result labels and a keyboard-hint footer.

components.name: Files
components.description: On-demand lazy file tree and read-only preview, switching from narrow drill-in to tree/preview columns by available panel width.

components.name: Settings
components.description: Native split navigation and grouped forms, including a configurable system-mono font preview.

components.name: File Manager
components.description: Native two-ended file listing with device and path controls, conflict handling, transfer actions and byte progress.

components.name: Reconnect Overlay
components.description: Compact regular-material explanation and Reconnect action above the affected terminal.

narrative.overview:
HerdrX is a simple, clean native macOS workbench. Terminals own the visual field; compact navigation makes local shells, device workspaces and coding agents easy to reach. Files appear beside the terminal only when requested.

SwiftUI and AppKit supply system typography, familiar controls and keyboard behavior; Ghostty supplies the terminal canvas. Preserve HerdrX's name and user-supplied purple diagonal slash on a white icon tile. Keep that identity in the app icon and product surfaces without repeating it as decoration across the workbench.
keyCharacteristics: Terminal-first density with a single integrated top bar.
Theme-aware surfaces, semantic system controls and explicit focus.
Stable sidebar actions with compact, collapsible navigation groups.
On-demand file browsing and native settings without decorative card chrome.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Keep platform colors semantic and source-defined theme colors explicit. Do not freeze a screenshot's appearance into a new palette.

rules.name: The Reading Rule
rules.body: Preserve native text metrics and user-selected terminal typography; truncate navigation labels and retain their full context in tooltips.

rules.name: The Terminal Space Rule
rules.body: Keep the main detail area available to terminals; reveal file tools on demand and return their space when closed.

dos: Do retain HerdrX identity and native SwiftUI/AppKit controls.
Do keep terminal content dominant, navigation compact and file tools on demand.
Do use shape and accessible text with status color; keep device connection and agent execution states distinct.
Do verify both appearances, long Chinese labels and the specified window sizes with the running native app.
Do treat the source scan, rendered review and behavioral acceptance as separate evidence.
donts: Don't replace native controls or the real terminal with a web theme, raster mockup or simulated terminal.
Don't restore a second fixed toolbar or a persistent bottom status bar.
Don't invent fixed equivalents for macOS dynamic colors or platform text styles.
Don't add decorative shadows, oversized branding or card containers around terminal panes.
Don't invent runtime metadata, hide context behind controls or claim full parity from screenshots.
